request.candidates_and_roles: No candidates have been trained, evaluated, or assigned a working, best-known, or retained role.
request.cumulative_resource_use: No training, evaluation, or other scientific operation has completed; cumulative campaign resource use is zero.
request.current_goal_gap: No learned candidate or episode evidence exists, so the campaign has no measured success rate. The known structural gap is that training currently samples only 0.14-0.20 m while the official distribution includes 0.06-0.20 m; the model also identifies settling and uninterrupted hold stability as unmeasured requirements.
request.current_synthesis: Observed from the campaign-start physical model: every official target is statically reachable on at least one inverse-kinematic branch, but success additionally requires reaching, removing residual motion, and remaining inside the 1 cm disk for 100 consecutive sampled observations. The current training support excludes 0.06-0.14 m, and no evidence yet establishes whether unsupported low-radius geometry, hold regulation on supported targets, or both dominate failure. These are hypotheses, not findings.
request.decision_frontier: The next decision requires a baseline candidate measured on the official target distribution with episode diagnostics separated by target geometry and by trajectory phase: first entry, settling, longest uninterrupted hold, interruptions, and timeout distance. That evidence will discriminate distribution coverage failure from closed-loop stabilization failure before committing to an intervention.
request.human_goal_connection: The only success criterion is at least 196 successes in 200 official episodes, where each success requires a complete uninterrupted 100-control-step hold. The initial direction must therefore target full-distribution closed-loop reliability rather than distance or return alone.
request.next_direction_or_closure: After this checkpoint, goal review should open a bounded inquiry to establish the first baseline failure mechanism. A credible initial direction is to treat full-distribution target coverage and hold-oriented closed-loop stabilization as coupled requirements, then choose the intervention from stratified baseline evidence rather than optimizing shaped return locally.
